update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.37 - Trackblazer shop fix + race win detection
Fixes --- - Trackblazer shop now buys items: unlock/discount dialog is dismissed before the purchase flow starts - Purchased-item detection tightened so buyable rows are not skipped on false badge matches - Smart Race Solver no longer records a loss when you actually won (Congratulations banner latched and retried) - Stops incorrect "Race lost" Discord alerts after a win
Includes v5.9.35 generation farm and session improvements.
